_comment: TA-ONLY answer key for lab 1. Do NOT ship in the student package. Bound to the pinned capture by sha256; the checker refuses to grade a different file.

password.note: Publicly documented; required but never sufficient on its own. Packet evidence below carries the individualized credit.

handshake_frames.note: Accept any one complete 4-message EAPOL handshake set, order-insensitive.

ping_pair.note: Request/reply must be a matching decrypted ICMP pair.

payload_hex.note: frame 56 data.data; accept with or without 0x, case-insensitive.

remaining_encryption_protocol.note: The inner encryption still present after Wi-Fi decryption.

manual_review.prompt: Short free-text: why does recovering this WPA2 password NOT let you read the ESP (inner) traffic, and what is the difference between the Wi-Fi encryption layer and the additional encryption inside it?
manual_review.note: Graded by a TA; not scored by the automated checker.
